content_zh:
第41章 赵红旗兴奋了，开始狩猎獐子-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

下一章

“嘘嘘嘘……！”

李青山对着大壮二壮和赵红旗嘘声，缓缓弯下腰朝着前面缓步移动，赵红旗和二壮一脸懵逼，这是怎么了？

发现野物了？

可是，野物呢？

自己怎么没有见到？

就在赵红旗和二壮懵逼的时候，李青山放下手中猎枪，反而将猎弓取了出来。

前面四十米的位置，是一只野兔。

完全没必要用猎枪的独头弹，毕竟独头弹是要成本的，李青山身上只有五枚，不能浪费了，猎弓足矣。

猎弓满月。

“嗖！”

空中传来一道破空声，长箭瞬间没入野兔的颈部，将其钉死在地上。

中了！

就在大黄准备冲出去的时候，李青山却是再次猎弓满月，又是一箭射了出去。

这一箭，直接没入一处杂草堆内。

紧接着。

大壮等人便看到杂草内似乎有野物正在挣扎，大黄的黄色身影已经冲了出去。

“走！”

李青山收了长弓，十分满意。

这次运气很不错，刚刚出门进入老林子，便射了两只野兔子，今天晚上的晚饭是有了。

“这就，打到野物了？”

二壮和赵红旗相互对视一眼，脸上满是震惊和骇然道。

特别是李青山的第二箭，他是怎么看到杂草丛里面还有一只野兔子的？

"Shhhhhhh...!"

Li Qingshan booed at Da Zhuang, Er Zhuang and Zhao Hongqi, and slowly bent down and moved forward slowly. Zhao Hongqi and Er Zhuang looked confused, what's going on?

Found a wild animal?

But what about wild animals?

Why didn't you see it yourself?

Just when Zhao Hongqi and Er Zhuang were confused, Li Qingshan put down the hunting rifle in his hand and took out the hunting bow instead.

Forty meters ahead was a hare.

There was absolutely no need to use single-ended bullets from the hunting rifle. After all, single-ended bullets cost money. Li Qingshan only had five of them, so he couldn't waste them. A hunting bow was enough.

Hunting bow full moon.

"Whoosh!"

There was a sound of breaking through the air, and the long arrow instantly penetrated the hare's neck, nailing it to the ground.

Hit!

Just when Dahuang was about to rush out, Li Qingshan used his bow again and shot out another arrow.

This arrow sank directly into a pile of weeds.

Immediately afterwards.

Da Zhuang and others saw that there seemed to be wild animals struggling in the weeds, and the yellow figure of Dahuang had already rushed out.

"Let's go!"

Li Qingshan put away his long bow and was very satisfied.

This time I was very lucky. As soon as I entered the old forest, I shot two wild rabbits, and I had dinner tonight.

"Did you hit a wild animal?"

Er Zhuang and Zhao Hongqi looked at each other with shock and horror on their faces.

Especially Li Qingshan's second arrow, how did he see a wild rabbit in the weeds?
